title: Ignore shared append-only files when grouping plan items in parallel
summary: Plan grouping (plan.rs `disjoint`) treats two items touching the same CHANGELOG.md or docs/decisions.md as a clash, so every parallel group is a single item. Change it so those shared append-only files are excluded from the overlap test, as parallel-jobs.md section 9 proposes. Audience: the maintainer running `plan`/drain who wants parallel groups.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests for the new grouping; cargo test and clippy pass.
Fixes the overlap rule that makes all groups singletons, not a per-item workaround.
Criteria check items actually grouping together.
One focused change in one function.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The fix goes in plan.rs overlap/disjoint logic, not in the pool serialization of section 9 rule 3, which is a different mechanism.
Shared files are CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md and README.md, as listed in section 9.
An entry whose only touched paths are shared files counts as naming no other path, so it stays ungrouped (conservative).
CHANGELOG.md is touched per the standing changelog default.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new plan.rs unit test shows two entries that touch disjoint code files plus the same CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md land in one parallel group; run `cargo test -p athena-core plan`.

A test shows two entries that both touch the same non-shared file (e.g. crates/core/src/x.rs) still land in separate groups, and an entry touching only CHANGELOG.md is still not grouped with another (nothing else known); run `cargo test -p athena-core plan`.
cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets pass, and cargo fmt --check is clean.

The shared append-only list (CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md, README.md) is one named constant in plan.rs with a doc comment citing parallel-jobs.md section 9, and the module docs describe the exception.
The change stays within plan grouping; the docs say landing-check authority for conflicting shared-file edits is unchanged.

out_of_scope: Implementing the docs-job-writes-shared-files rule or decision-number allocation
